Synopsis:
Orin, Chosen of Bhaal resides in Bhaal Temple, waiting for the players to arrive. She has given them an ultimatum to kill Gortash and retrieve his Netherstone for her, or the player's abducted companion will be sacrified.  If the players didn't have a valid companion for kidnapping, Yenna will take the place of sacrifice.Depending on the approach the player took to the altar, they may be in a slightly different position relative to the altar. Orin will teleport into the same spot on the alter in order to begin the dialogue.Regardless of the player's actions within the temple, and regardless of Gortash's fate, Orin will eventually begin a fight with the players. Determined to prove to Bhaal and herself that she is a worthy Chosen of Bhaal.She will transform into the slayer in the final moments of the dialogue, and then combat begins.

Cluster Contexts:
- LOW_BhaalTemple_Orin.json: Orin is the Bhaal Chosen waiting in the temple’s inner sanctum; earlier she abducted (or will abduct) one of the player’s companions — or Yenna if no valid companion existed — and has ordered the party to kill Gortash and bring her his Netherstone or the captive will be sacrificed. When the scene opens she teleports onto the altar, positions the victim between herself and the player, and taunts the party for any perceived disobedience while threatening the captive (drawing blades to the throat in the shown cinematics). The provided lines show the player claiming Gortash is dead; Orin breathes in the news, revels at corpse‑rot, then murders the victim and turns her wrath on the player. Regardless of positioning or what else is happening nearby, she will transform into her slayer form at the dialogue’s end and initiate combat. (Depending on unrelated prior actions, off‑screen disturbances — e.g., a windmill mishap that drew goblins in other clusters — might be occurring but don’t alter Orin’s behavior here.)
- LOW_BhaalTemple_OM_OrinDarkUrge_AOM.json: Orin, Chosen of Bhaal resides in Bhaal Temple, waiting for the players to arrive. She has given them an ultimatum to kill Gortash and retrieve his Netherstone for her, or the players' abducted companion will be sacrified.  If the players didn't have a valid companion for kidnapping, a random citizen will take the place of sacrifice.Orin has multiple reactivity to the player's previous actions.- was Orin attacked during her Impersonations several times?- are players Unholy Assassins?- did/didn't players kill Gortash?- are players DarkUrge?- did Orin kidnap a romance partner, friend or random citizen?- did players kill Sarevok?- was Orin warned of the players coming and therefore kills the victim immediately?Regardless of the various player choices, Orin will eventually begin a fight with the players, determined to prove to Bhaal and herself that she is a worthy Chosen of Bhaal.If players had rejected the Dark Urge earlier, she will turn into the Slayer before combat.
- CAMP_OrinAbduction_CFM_Yenna.json: When no valid companion for abduction is available, Orin insteadbducts Yenna -  a beggar child who previously greeted players when they entered Wyrm’s Crossing, and who subsequently keeps appearing in their camp. Appearing as Yenna, Orin will try to get the player to drink a poisoned soup, before revealing herself.



 She tells the player that the real Yenna is in the Bhaal Temple, and gives them an ultimatum about killing Gortash and retrieving the Netherstone. If they do this, then she will not kill Yenna, and will duel the player instead.
- LOW_BhaalTemple_DeathsHead_02_AD_DarkUrgeDuel.json: In the Bhaal Temple, if players are Dark Urge, they have the opportunity to fight Orin one on one. Players are given a warning that if the companions jump in the battle, so does the rest of the temple.
- LOW_BhaalTemple_PostBattleDarkUrge.json: Orin, Chosen of Bhaal, has died by the DarkUrge's/party's hands.If the DU deafted Orin, Bhaal will celebrate his new Chosen and force a decision on them - accept him, or he will reclaim his blood from them.If the player was defeated, the player sees a linear scene where Bhaal inflicts his blood on them, leaving them with the urge to kill, but not his slayer powers.

context: Orin, a Chosen of Bhaal, waits in the temple’s inner sanctum after abducting one of the party’s companions (or Yenna / a random citizen if no valid companion was available) and has given the party an ultimatum: kill Gortash and bring her his Netherstone or the captive will be sacrificed. When the scene opens she teleports onto the altar, positions the victim between herself and the player, and taunts the party while pressing blades to the captive’s throat. If the player already killed Gortash, Orin scents his “corpse‑rot,” revels in it, and often slaughters the victim as punishment for perceived disobedience before turning her wrath on the player. Regardless of prior choices, positioning, or nearby off‑screen disturbances, Orin will transform into her slayer form at the dialogue’s end and immediately initiate combat.
